back: Square root of the mean of squared percentage errors, (actual − prediction) / actual. Zero-sales days are ignored.
Predict daily sales of 1,115 German stores for 48 days after the training data.
Closed means zero sales. The rule is exact and the metric ignores those days anyway.

front: Which Rossmann columns exist in test.csv?
back: Id, Store, DayOfWeek, Date, Open, Promo, StateHoliday, SchoolHoliday. No Sales and no Customers.
A learned short vector for each category value, such as a store, used as input to a neural network.

front: Who wrote the entity embeddings paper?
back: Cheng Guo and Felix Berkhahn, the 3rd-place team in Rossmann, in 2016.
